House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Health Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; clarifying requirements for maternal death studies; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 145.901, subdivision 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 145.901, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Purpose.
The commissioner of health [-may-][+ must+] conduct maternal death studies to assist the planning, implementation, and evaluation of medical, health, and welfare service systems and to reduce the numbers of preventable maternal deaths in Minnesota.
